retrieved.text: On the public admissions scholarship page, the university states a continuation CGPA of 8 on a 10-point scale. Students who entered without an admission scholarship may qualify for a 10% academic scholarship, subject to the university policy.

The admissions scholarship page describes a limited pool allocated first come, first served. Meeting published criteria does not give an applicant a guaranteed scholarship. If several awards apply, the university grants the one with the greatest value under its guidelines.

Students normally have 15 days from announcement of results to submit the prescribed re-evaluation form to the Controller of Examinations and pay the applicable fee. The manual lists a non-refundable charge of ₹5,000 for each subject, subject to changes in university policy. Incomplete forms can be rejected.

The Vice-Chancellor chooses an independent reviewer from a panel suggested by the Controller of Examinations. The reviewer receives a digital copy of the answer sheet with identifying details masked. If the first review differs from the original marks by over 20%, a different evaluator conducts another review and the two review scores are averaged.

The notice dated 17 June 2025 announced May 2025 even-semester results for other schools and semesters. The notice set 19 June 2025 as the result date for B.Tech CSE semesters 2 and 6. Students were directed to check their ERP account.
